children: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has certified the newest and largest Boeing 737 MAX airplane, the 737-10, clearing the way for the aircraft maker to begin deliveries in the coming months. The 737-10 completes the 737 MAX family, which offers airlines a flexible single-aisle airplane lineup, says a statement from the company.

The largest model builds on the family’s common architecture while taking capabilities to a new level, it said. It can serve 230 passengers in the maximum seating configuration and offers the lowest per seat cost of any single-aisle airplane in service, Boeing said. The airplane also introduces safety enhancements, including an upgraded angle-of-attack system, which will become standard across the 737 MAX family.

Mitsui OSK Lines Ltd (MOL) recently held a joint naming ceremony at CSSC Qingdao Beihai Shipbuilding Co Ltd, part of the China State Shipbuilding Corporation (CSSC), for the world’s first three ammonia-fuelled Capesize bulk carriers, which are being jointly developed with the Belgian shipping group CMB.TECH NV. Upon their scheduled delivery, starting around early 2027, the vessels will be jointly owned by MOL and CMB.TECH. MOL plans to operate the vessels under long-term charter contracts.

title: US regulator certifies Boeing 737-10
